'''December 2001 Richmond tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Richmond, Virginia on 1 December 2001. [[Tim Davis]] won it. It is known from Devon Clark's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3146">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-06-r2-for-r3-mistakes-in-richmond-12d3146/ r2-for-r3-mistakes-in-richmond-12], DeckTech (Devon "Devonator" Clark, 6 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-06-r2-for-r3-mistakes-in-richmond-12d3146/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Richmond, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Tim Davis]]
